the_horizon_that_actually_binds.the_gap: the engine SETS `repeat` on the observation and CLOSES THE LOOP with it, and the text the round sees renders only [ok] or [FAILED]. The round is told a budget that does not bind and not told the rule that does.
the_horizon_that_actually_binds.the_round_s_behaviour_is_then_reasonable: it re-reads the ledger to confirm what it measured -- a sound instinct -- and that confirmation is what ends its loop before it can write.

the_repair.what: observations now render as [ok, REPEAT of a call you already made], and a round containing any repeat is told: 'A round in which EVERY call is a repeat ENDS THE LOOP IMMEDIATELY, whatever budget is left. If you have a result, record it now; do not re-read to confirm it.'
the_repair.the_budget_message_stays: it is correct and it will bind on a round that spends its observations rather than repeating. Wrong-target, not wrong.
